context_no-partitions: There are no partitions to display
hint_cpu_usage: CPU time consumed by the job of a partition, averaged over 10 minutes and recalculated to vCPU.
hint_memory_usage: Heap allocated by the job of a partition, including its companion process, averaged over 10 minutes. The allocator samples allocations, so values of a few megabytes are within the error.
hint_messages_per_second: Rate of messages read from the input streams of a partition. Computations without input streams (sources) report zero.
hint_bytes_per_second: Rate of bytes read from the input streams of a partition. Computations without input streams (sources) report zero.
